notes.basis: proxy volumes, same method as REF

extra.summary: Slotted 6061 plate + two serrated adapter strips + 8 mm shim packs + shortened S1 block: P re-fits +-10 z (1.5 mm teeth), +-8 x (shims 0.5/1/2/4), 3 wedge options (0/+-5 deg, fit only, lock at 0), same 4 x M5 columns; armour oversized to clear the range.
pros: re-fit to Forest's measured body (I7) by loosening 4 bolts, no new plate/wing/pipeline run for P offsets within +-10 z / +-8 x
wing, rail, clasp feet and plate outline unchanged
same 4 x M5 column pattern and S1 bore; stage, cowl, dome untouched
tilt wedges give a fit option without re-cutting anything
cons: adapter+shims+backing bars+gaiter add ~84 g; net +21.7 g on the proxy basis after the shorter block and trimmed armour (spares: 2 wedges 17.8 g not counted)
more joints: 3 more faces that can creep/loosen; PETG-CF block bearing on pad shims
tilt wedge moves P 7 mm and tilts the S1 axis: head keep-out/keepout tables must be re-run per wedge
armour needs a TPU gaiter and a bigger spaulder scallop (less flush by ~2 mm gap)
risks: serration y-slip is friction only (ridges run along y)
backing bars on plate front may collide with clasp feet locations (clasp_feet.json not available)
5 deg wedge breaks the 2026-10-12c 'mount tilt withdrawn' choice (Claude decision, not Forest's): option for FIT only, ships at 0, locked by omitting wedge
contract_changes: plate: 4 x M5 tapped holes -> 4 slots (5.5 x 25.5) + 2 serrated grooved strips (1.5 pitch x 0.8 deep, y +-9.5 about +-62, z -126..-54)
plate: 2 x M4 keel csk holes at (+-50,-109) deleted (keel now bolts to adapter tabs)
plate front: 2 backing bars (x -91..-88) tapped M5
S1 base block 80 -> 67 mm deep, bolt holes become through-clearance
spaulder rear edge scalloped around the swept crown
crown/keel rear edge x -84 -> -58, rear of the round plan cut off flat (the 73.5 mm radius would hit the plate at dx -8); TPU gaiter closes to the plate
decision_conflicts: 'Mount tilt withdrawn' (Claude, 2026-10-12c): reintroduced only as selectable fit wedges, default 0 deg
no Forest-decision conflict: no backplate, no hip belt, 5 deg stop margin, DOF, actuators unchanged
gates_to_rerun: verify_armor + verify_shoulder at the adjustment extremes
harness_loads (net +~22 g proxy -> top pad ~+0.06 kPa est; verify vs 14.7)
keepout_map/elbow tables for any non-zero wedge
scapular_frame tongue/clasp feet vs backing bars
assumptions: clasp F1/F4 seats assumed; ref plate outline from spec seeds
6061 adapter strips CNC (printing 0.8 mm teeth is not credible)
M5 8.8 bolts, usable preload 2 kN each (unverified; PETG-CF block creep not measured)

calcs.name: joint separation moment
calcs.formula: M_sep = F_c * a ; a = half bolt-column span 26 mm/2 + ~3 mm = 16 mm (pivot at block lower edge: a=34 mm lower bound uses 32)

calcs.name: bolt tension from bending
calcs.formula: M = 8.3 (S2 cap) + m g L ; T_top = M / 32 mm (pivot bottom edge to top bolts)

calcs.name: z-shear vs tooth jack-up
calcs.formula: F_slip = F_c * tan(alpha + atan(mu)) ; alpha 30 deg half-flank

calcs.name: P-position error budget
calcs.formula: z quantisation +-pitch/2; x quantisation +-0.25 (0.5 mm leaf); tilt: dP = 80 sin(5 deg), tip = 580 sin(5 deg); slot clearance 0.25 -> angle 0.25/124 rad at 575 mm

extra.printability: adapter strips and backing bars: CNC 6061 (or waterjet + tooth cut); shim leaves laser-cut; wedges PA-CF flat on bed; crown/keel/spaulder as REF (all < 256 mm); teeth must NOT be printed.
extra.fitting_procedure: 1) wear the harness with arm at park; 2) Forest measures acromion-to-P height and the P-to-back standoff (tape against a rigid jig, or a scan); 3) loosen 4 M5 (arm weight supported), slide the block in z by the delta (snap to 1.5 mm teeth), add/remove shim leaves for x, retighten to the torque in the spec (target 5 N.m, unverified); 4) re-zero S2 if a wedge is used; about 10 minutes, no re-print.
